maintenance_led.reason: Sells refrigerated fresh dog and cat food, a consumable used up in normal operation, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Pet food bought by consumers through retailers like Costco and direct subscription; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling more fresh pet food, building its own kitchens and refrigerated retail presence, not through acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Pet owners can switch to other dog food brands easily; consumer food with no qualification or regulatory barriers.
